t: This is the home of Save the Children, the London-based international charity. It was founded in 1919 by Eglantyne Jebb and her sister Dorothy Buxton, with the first aim of feeding children during the Blockade of Germany. In 1921 it was decided that it would become permanent, as needs had been recognised across Europe and Russia. Jebb was a social reformer who also drafted the document that became the Declaration of the Rights of the Child. Buxton was a humanitarian and social activist.
